title: Oven-Stewed Ethiopian Oatmeal Stew
description: A resinous, tender stew featuring oats and yakimono-grilled vegetables, perfect for a date-night Ethiopian meal and Whole30-friendly.
instructions: Place diced carrots, celery, onion, and garlic on a yakimono grill and grill until lightly charred, about 4-5 minutes per side.
Transfer the charred vegetables to a large oven-safe pot.
Add olive oil to the pot and sauté the vegetables for 2 minutes to bloom aromatics.
Sprinkle berbere spice, ginger, salt, and pepper over the vegetables and stir to combine.
Pour in vegetable broth, bring to a gentle simmer, then stir in rolled oats.
Cover the pot with a lid and bake uncovered for 35 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes, until oats are tender and the stew thickened.
Remove from oven, let rest 5 minutes, then serve hot.
